blocks.text: INQUIRER.net / Updated as of: 07:34 AM November 01, 2026

MANILA, Philippines — Millions of Filipinos are expected to visit cemeteries and memorial parks across the country on Sunday, November 1, to pay tribute to their departed loved ones as they observe All Saints’ Day.

Follow this page for reports and latest developments in the situation at cemeteries and memorial parks nationwide, including crowd conditions, traffic, security measures, and public transportation./ dp
DOE said it is monitoring the country’s electricity and fuel supply amid the expected increase in travel and activity during the “Undas.”
